title: RenderPlan v1.0
description: Hop dong duy nhat giua Laravel (Semantic OS) va Python (Compiler + Runtime). Xem docs/video/ARCHITECTURE.md. Laravel emit, Python consume, mot chieu. TUYET DOI khong duoc chua prompt language, ky thuat render, hay ten provider.

category.description: Slug category CMS cua bai. OPTIONAL, additive (v1.0 §14): compiler Python nap ho so tri thuc nganh theo slug nay — xuong dong tau, nha may o to, xuong dua co goc may/vai tho/do bao ho khac nhau. Khong co slug hoac khong co ho so tuong ung thi Python KHONG bom gi (khong suy dien).

world_environment.description: Moi truong CAP VIDEO (khong phai cap scene) - projection tu MOT Landscape entity duy nhat trong World Graph (EditorialInterpreter::environmentFor(), Sprint 2 2026-07-22). OPTIONAL, vang khi Truth khong co hoac co >=2 Landscape entity (khong doan cai nao dung scene nao). Chua co co che gan environment rieng cho tung scene (can quan he located_in giua Landscape va subject - chua co bang chung can, Rule 0). scene.world (duoi $defs/scene) VAN la field rieng, danh cho tuong lai khi co per-scene projection that - hai field nay KHONG duoc dong bo gia.

creative_identity.description: Nhan dang THI GIAC cap VIDEO cua chu the chinh — mau vo, so tang, dang mui, dai kinh... OPTIONAL. Day KHONG phai Truth: bai bao thuong khong noi mau son hay so tang (bang chung bai 'The Sixth Sense' 2026-07-29: Truth chi cho vessel_type + length). Day la LUA CHON EDITORIAL, duoc phep bia, rang buoc duy nhat la BAT BIEN xuyen cac scene. Ton tai vi da chung minh duoc chu KHONG suy doan: 3 clip nhan dung cung mot cau nhan dang tu Truth van ra 3 con tau khac nhau, vi Truth qua ngheo (§18.15). Sibling cua world_environment va cung ban chat: fact cap video, compiler ap per-scene co gating (identity_visible_at). Hai trang thai vi cung mot con tau trong khac han luc dang thi cong va luc hoan thien — do la time cue, khong phai mau thuan. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §18.16-18.17.

permanent.description: Nhan dang KHONG BAO GIO doi trong suot vong doi vat the — hinh hoc than vo, ty le, dang mui/duoi. Tach khoi `construction` ngay 2026-08-07 vi mot ly do do duoc: prompt cua chuoi dung xay dan (moi buoc CHI THEM mot lop) ma lai mang cau mo ta trang thai thi cong thi no TU MAU THUAN — vua bao 'giu nguyen moi thu' vua ta mot giai doan khac. `construction` van giu cau trang thai (dung cho anh neo, sinh tu so khong); `permanent` chi giu thu bat bien (dung cho moi mat xich sau do). Cung $ref nen cung hinh dang; khac nhau o AI DOC, khong o cau truc.

producer.description: Creative direction cap PHIM (Producer role). OPTIONAL - plan khong co van hop le v1.0. Validated bang render 2026-07-19. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md 17.

type.description: Ontology chung. KHONG duoc la domain type (superyacht, sports_car). Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §3.

attributes.description: Thuoc tinh VAT LY, render duoc. Chay xuong ProviderIR. Free-form vi day la domain data (hop le - data, khong phai code).

environment.description: Vocabulary dong cho fact moi truong - dung chung boi world_environment (cap video) va scene.world (cap scene, RESERVED). TAT CA optional field - Truth khong co gi thi vang, khong bia.

visual_referent.description: SEMANTIC: ten nay co ghim xuong mot hinh dang cu the khong? Titanic=true, Jan Koum=false. Laravel KHONG duoc khang dinh model AI biet ten nay - do la viec cua ProviderPass allowlist ben Python. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §4.

semantic.description: Danh tinh / nguon goc. KHONG BAO GIO xuong ProviderIR. VD: owner, builder, price.

visual_hint.description: Chi tiet hinh anh lay TU BAI BAO. Python KHONG duoc bia them. Xem memory feedback_data_provenance.

act.description: Act = mot node hoac edge cua World Graph duoc chon de ke. Dung MOT ref, khop voi source. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §3.

motion_intent.description: Thay the content_type cua kien truc cu. Laravel chi tra loi 'canh nay co can chuyen dong khong?'. Laravel KHONG duoc biet Ken Burns/Kling ton tai. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §1.

setting.description: BOI CANH scene — noi chon, KHOA NGU NGHIA thuan — khong mot chu tieng Anh nao. Laravel so huu SU THAT (canh nay dien ra o loai noi nao), Python so huu CACH NOI. OPTIONAL: scene khong dien ra o mot co so san xuat (ban ve, tren boong, ngoai bien) thi BO HAN key — khong bia noi chon. KHAC `scene.world`: `world` la World FACTS tu Truth (§13, RESERVED, vang khi khong co bang chung); `setting` la lua chon EDITORIAL (Creation Arc boi co chu dich). Dat chung ten se lam mot cai nuot cai kia trong JSON va tron hai loai tri thuc. Enum khai o day de typo bi bat ngay tai Laravel; Python gap khoa la thi NEM, khong fallback.

aesthetic.description: Editorial taste — LUON co mat, khong phu thuoc chu de. Day KHONG phai fact; Editorial dien default tham my khi khong co gi dac biet. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §13.

world.description: World FACTS cap SCENE tu Truth — TAT CA optional. RESERVED: chua co planner nao gan gia tri rieng cho tung scene (xem top-level world_environment cho projection cap-video hien tai). Vang khi Truth khong co bang chung; KHONG BAO GIO thay bang default hay suy luan. Provider tu dien bang world-knowledge cua no khi vang. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §13.

objective.description: Tai scene nay, nguoi xem can nhan duoc dieu gi. MOT ngu nghia duy nhat, NHIEU NGUON CUNG CAP (§18.18) — (a) producer.visual_promise copy nguyen van, dung khi scene mo ta CUNG trang thai voi thanh pham (da so scene that); (b) planner sinh ra scene tu viet, BAT BUOC khi scene mo ta trang thai KHAC (Creation Arc: ban ve, khoi thep tran — va moi arc sau nay). Nguon doi thi ngu nghia field KHONG doi. Ten field la 'objective' vi §14 FROZEN chi cho additive — dung doc ten nay la 'ban copy cua visual_promise'. TUYET DOI KHONG phai Compiler tu sinh tu purpose enum. OPTIONAL, vang khi khong co nguon nao. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §17/§18/§18.18.

requires_state.description: TRANG THAI vat the ma canh nay doi thay trong ANH NGUON cua shot chuyen dong. Additive vao v1.0 ngay 2026-08-07 theo §14. Can that: khong co no thi Python phai giu ban sao thu hai cua bang `phase => trang thai` da khai o config/video.php, va hai ban sao se lech IM LANG (video van ra, chi la sai anh nguon). Day la ngu nghia CAU CHUYEN nen thuoc Laravel; Python chi so khop CHUOI CHINH XAC, khong dien giai, khong tim gan dung. Tu vung dong, khai tai media_runtime/design/data/construction_chains/*.json truong `states` — dat ten dong nghia moi ('shell_complete' thay vi 'hull_shell') la khong khop. OPTIONAL: vang nghia la canh KHONG rang buoc trang thai, KHONG phai 'doan ho mot cai'.

director_notes.description: Y do sang tao cua MOT canh (Director role) — tra loi 'khan gia nen CAM thay gi', KHONG phai prompt. OPTIONAL. Provider-doc-lap: song sot khi doi Kling→Veo. style_shift: canh duoc lech style toan-phim KHI cam xuc doi hoi (bang chung beat 4, 2026-07-19). hero/primary/secondary/micro_physics them 2026-07-21/22 (Phase 3, ARCHITECTURE.md §18.4): Director CHI chon (hero id + index candidate), KHONG tu viet cau — primary/secondary la SEMANTIC (type/actor/target), KHONG phai Prompt Language (§18.7 Syntax thuoc Compiler). hero/target co the VANG (khong bia — xem ActionCandidate::toArray()/ActionSelection::resolve()). composition_note them 2026-07-23: cau mo ta DAN CANH (tien canh/hau canh, cai gi noi bat) — CHI duoc ghep tu hero/primary/secondary/attribute DA CO trong candidates, KHONG duoc bia chi tiet moi (van evidence-gated, chi doi CACH trinh bay). narrative_goal/visual_priority/camera_philosophy/avoid/style_shift van RESERVED, chua noi day. Xem ARCHITECTURE.md §17/§18.

features.description: Thuoc tinh DA VERIFY ma Director chon de nhan manh (them 2026-08-13, additive). Ton tai vi `composition_note` la van xuoi — doc no khong biet cau nay chung minh duoc hay Director bia. Field nay giu provenance co cau truc: entity nao, thuoc tinh nao, gia tri nao. CHI chua feature DA DUOC CHON, khong phai toan bo danh sach da dua Director. OPTIONAL.

new_information.description: Canh nay noi dieu gi ma cac canh truoc chua noi (them 2026-08-13, additive). Director sinh ra, roi duoc dua NGUOC vao PREVIOUS SCENES cua cac canh sau — day la co che chong lap giua cac canh. Luu vao RenderPlan de QA truy nguoc duoc canh nao lap canh nao; giu lam working memory thi mat dau ngay sau pipeline. OPTIONAL: canh khong qua Director (Creation Arc) khong co field nay.

crowd.description: So nguoi trong khung, theo VAI. Quyet dinh cua DAO DIEN — dong de thay dai cong truong, hay mot nguoi de thay quy mo co may. Nam trong director_notes vi day la BLOCKING (cung nhom hero/camera/micro_physics), KHONG phai tri thuc nganh: ho so category chi noi workers LA AI (roles + PPE), khong noi BAO NHIEU. Hai planner cung quyet so nguoi thi prompt tu mau thuan — bang chung 2026-08-03: prose ghi 'a lone worker' trong khi ho so ep 'Exactly 6 people'. OPTIONAL: vang thi compiler khong ep so, canh de model tu quyet.

action.description: Hanh dong SEMANTIC (khong phai cau tieng Anh) — type/actor/target/modifiers. Python Compiler moi dich thanh ngon ngu (§18.7 Syntax). target OPTIONAL: hanh dong tu Event (1 entity, vd 'nas performs') khong co doi tuong tac dong nhu hanh dong tu Relation (2 entity) — KHONG bia target. Xem ActionType.php.

identity_state.description: Nhan dang thi giac o MOT giai doan vong doi. La OBJECT chu khong phai string thuan — de sau nay them duoc palette/materials/prohibitions/silhouette ma van additive, khong pha contract. Hien chi co visual_identity; them field moi phai co bang chung that, khong them truoc.

visual_identity.description: MOT cau mo ta chu the o giai doan nay, dung de compiler nhac lai o moi scene nhin thay duoc dang tong the. KHONG phai prompt hoan chinh — compiler moi ghep no voi camera/lighting/action.
